name: giant octopus
desc: Giant Octopus is a CR 1 beast.

actions.name: water breathing
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.

actions.name: tentacles
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from all eight tentacles. While Grappled, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition.

actions.name: ink cloud
actions.desc: Trigger: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes damage while underwater. Response: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} releases ink that fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=1MiIPcVuCpfgBIkS]]-foot Cube centered on itself, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
